methodology: 60 new internally authored prose cases with different people, systems and text, frozen after general judge-input fixes and before first execution. Author knows implementation patterns, so labels are not independent human/enterprise ground truth. No tuning on this corpus; original results are preserved. Cases target supported explicit duties, dependencies, rationale and uncertainty.
scoring: Exact candidate identity and owner/rationale; dependency endpoints compare after removing leading definite article 'the'. Original first-run reports are immutable.
false_negatives: The assigned engineer handles artifact verification. The authorised evidence does not name that engineer.
